title: NDIS Provider
description: One record per NDIS-registered provider, sourced from the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission Provider Register (CC BY 4.0 AU). Outlets are nested because the source register lists one row per outlet per provider.

provider_id.description: ABN. Stable identifier, already public via ABN Lookup.

business_name.description: Trading name (source: 'Provider business name'). Always safe to display.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name (source: 'Legal name'). Set to null when entity_type is 'individual' — see entity_type. Included as-is for organisations.

entity_type.description: Derived, not in source data. 'individual' means the legal name is a sole trader's personal name (e.g. 'CITIZEN, JANE MARY'); legal_name is withheld in that case and business_name is used instead. This is a deliberate minimisation choice, not a source-data field: the register's CC BY licence permits reusing the legal name, but the product doesn't need a sole trader's personal name to do its job, so it isn't republished.

registration_status.description: Source: 'Registration status'. Only 'Approved' and 'Revoked' observed in the current register; kept as open string rather than a hardcoded enum in case other statuses (e.g. Suspended) appear in future extracts.

registration_expiry.description: ISO 8601 date, parsed from source 'Period of registration in force until' (source format: 'DD Month YYYY').

items.description: NOTE: this is a working draft list built from the current extract. Regenerate this enum from a fresh CSV pull at build time rather than hardcoding it long-term — the Commission can add categories.

service_categories.description: Parsed by splitting source 'Approved registration groups' on ';' and trimming.

has_registration_conditions.description: True if source 'Conditions of registration' is non-empty. The raw condition text itself is withheld from this public schema in v1 (often long, and encoding in the source file is unreliable — see notes) — treat as a Phase 2 verified/detail-tier field, not a Phase 0 field.

head_office.description: Parsed from source 'Head office address', consistently formatted as 'SUBURB, STATE, POSTCODE, COUNTRY' in 63,569/63,573 rows verified. The remaining rows have no parseable address (source value was just 'AU') — suburb/state/postcode are null in that case rather than fabricated.

outlets.description: One entry per outlet row in the source register for this ABN. Empty array if the provider has no outlet rows beyond head office.

last_verified.description: Timestamp this record was last confirmed against its source (Phase 0: ingestion run time; Phase 1 onward: may reflect a provider's own self-service update). This is the seed of the Layer-3 trust story — always populate it, never fake it.
